title: I Tried to Make $10K in 10 Days With Costco Returns
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest runs a paid reselling mastermind (2,200 members) and a branded 'flip system'

idea.name: Flipping Costco return pallets bought on B-Stock
idea.one_liner: Bid on Costco customer-return truckloads (appliances, patio sets, gazebos) at ~$200-250/unit landed and resell locally on Facebook Marketplace at 50-70% of retail
idea.offer: returned/like-new appliances and outdoor goods with short personal warranty

key_quotes.quote: I think the sweet spot is the used good stuff.
Actually listing the things, responding lightning fast, and being willing to cut prices if you're not getting enough hits on them.
I'm going to give you 14 days. If you have a problem, just call me, bring it back.

claims.claim: Appliance load cost $243/unit incl. freight vs ~$1,150 Costco price
claims.quote: It looks like we're at going to be at like 243 per unit including freight.

claims.claim: 12-unit outdoor load (gazebos, sheds, patio sets) for $2,600
claims.quote: Again, the whole deal was $2,600 for how many units?

claims.claim: Most resellers operate from a garage
claims.quote: Most people do it out of the garage.

claims.claim: Washer bought at $243 listed at $879 against $1,300 retail
claims.quote: And then one listing of the stackable LG black brand new washer that retails for 1300.

acquisition_channels.details: video-first listings, ChatGPT SEO titles/descriptions, personal credibility line, free local delivery

ideas.delivery: store in garage or storage unit; test electrics; buyer pickup or local delivery partner (~$50)
ideas.other_uk_rules: Trader resale of used electrical/gas appliances must be safe (Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regs, Gas Appliances Regs) and Consumer Rights Act 2015 applies to business sellers
